error.invalid_config: Check sources, definitions, policy, and timings. Notifications require an enabled consumer automation. Homeostatic cannot monitor itself.

report_situation.name: Report situation
report_situation.description: Report an automation situation as active, cleared, or unknown. Refresh before its configured timeout. Does not enable notifications.

situation_id.name: Situation ID
situation_id.description: ID declared in Situation alerts with report_timeout and no entity.

state.name: Condition state
state.description: Active opens or updates; cleared resolves; unknown preserves an unresolved issue.

report_alert.name: Report alert
report_alert.description: Register or refresh an automation-owned condition. May request notifications using the selected shared profile.

automation.name: Automation
automation.description: Saved automation that owns this condition. Its stable HA ID supplies identity.

alert_key.name: Alert key
alert_key.description: Keep this stable. Use separate keys if one automation reports multiple conditions.

name.name: Name
name.description: Recognizable alert title; changing this does not change identity.

message.name: Message
message.description: Current evidence message. Supply rendered template text from the automation.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Existing Homeostatic reporting preference. Does not enable outgoing requests.

state.name: State
state.description: Active, observed clear, or unknown evidence. Only clear resolves the condition.

report_timeout.name: Report timeout
report_timeout.description: Evidence lifetime in seconds. Must exceed the report refresh interval.

adopt_situation_id.name: Adopt situation id
adopt_situation_id.description: Optional explicit conversion of a declared report-only situation; preserves its issue identity.

manage_alert.name: Manage automation alert
manage_alert.description: Retire monitoring or explicitly resume a retired alert. Retirement is not recovery.

alert_key.name: Alert key
alert_key.description: The same stable key used when reporting.

operation.name: Operation
operation.description: Retire blocks subsequent reports until explicitly resumed.
